_fixture: M10 Orion fan-out scene (Pulsar #60, ADR 003 Amendment 2 §A2.3 / F2). This is NOT the OBS scene graph the monitor_capture sources live in (those are created over obs-websocket by m10_setup.py against pulsar.exe). This is the ORION show scene whose ONLY job is to DECLARE the scene_control leaf path so Orion's Inbox.Write fans the Blue delta out to Prism's /show/stream subscription. Orion's sceneAcceptsPath (Orion/internal/adapters/inbox.go:78-87,102-124) drops any leaf no loaded scene declares in defaults / operator_inputs / bindings.target_paths. So the active M10 scene MUST declare __inputs.blue.m10-scene-control.scene_control or the switch silently no-ops (C-FANOUT precondition). The slug 'm10-scene-control' and the 3-segment path are pinned by the scene_control contract (scripts/contracts/scene_control/, fixtures/valid.json) and Blue #58; Prism #63 (SCENE_ALLOWLIST = {scene-screen-1, scene-screen-2}) consumes the resulting delta. The leaf type is 'json' because the scene_control value is a structured object (action/target_scene/transition), not a scalar; Orion seeds the declared default on boot and accepts the later Blue write in-scope. This scene renders nothing OBS-visible itself (it is the wire-declaration scene); the on-air composition is the two OBS monitor_capture scenes. scene_version is a zeroed placeholder the harness stamps with the real content hash (m9 parity).
